what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/coding/spec.md, dev.json and the code_tests checker in lab/core.py. Authored 21 skeleton-completion / helper-reuse tasks with a build script that assembles prompt, tests, reference and negative.
verification: Expected values in every assert were computed by executing the reference solution (exec/eval in the build script), then read against the prose spec. The script also asserts that every non-placeholder skeleton line appears verbatim in the reference and that each skeleton has 1-3 '...' placeholders. lab/validate_tasks.py then ran each reference (must pass) and each negative (must fail) in the sandbox.
notes: Difficulty labels are author estimates; no pilot was run, as required for held-out tasks.
Did not read other generators' files; overlap with them is unchecked.
